question: A scaffolding yard had 70 poles, and a hire return left it with 2 poles for every pole in the racks. Each pole was then cut into 4 shorter sections. A building site took 339 sections away. The yard then ordered 6 sections for every section it had left. The yard measures its steel in metres although the invoices are written in millimetres. How many sections does that order come to?

On Tuesday morning a toy factory moulded 197 trays, and each tray held 8 figures. By the afternoon every figure had been packed with 5 accessories. In the evening a supplier sent 18 accessories, and a returned order added 47 more. Half of the factory floor is used for storage, and the firm employs 210 people. How many accessories are there now?

On Monday morning a nail factory had 150 coils of wire, and a delivery added 65 more. Before noon each coil was cut into 8 blanks. During the afternoon 677 blanks failed the head test and were scrapped. In the early evening the plant made 4 nails from every blank it had left, and a supplier added 39 nails to the bin. Overnight head office ordered that whole bin again for each of 9 depots, needing that many nails per depot. How many nails does the whole order come to?

The Mirabel Print Shop received 9 identical pallets of blank posters, and every pallet held exactly 234 posters. The shop counts its stock in single sheets rather than in reams. A misaligned test run ruined 60 of the posters, a leak in the storeroom spoiled another 251, and a rush job for the town fair used up 370 more. Each poster that was still usable afterwards was then run through the copier to produce 8 finished copies of it. How many finished copies did the shop end up with?

Tomas kept 131 stamps in a shoebox at the start of the summer. At a collectors swap meet he traded so shrewdly that his pile tripled, ending up 3 times its earlier size. A neighbour then handed him 6 stamps from an old envelope, and later that month he sold 69 of his stamps to a dealer. He arranged everything he had left into 6 albums with the same number of stamps in every album, and he keeps the club records in minutes rather than in hours. How many stamps were in the album on his top shelf?

At dawn the Delmara cannery had 174 crates of olives in its yard, and a farmer arrived with 76 more crates. The plant weighs its fruit in kilograms and never in tonnes. Each crate was emptied into 7 barrels of brine, and by mid-morning a neighbouring farm sent over 53 extra barrels. A dozen inspectors walked the floor that day. During the afternoon 1302 barrels were loaded onto lorries and driven away. In the evening every remaining barrel was decanted into 4 drums, and each drum was sealed with 8 labels. How many labels were used?

Priya kept 136 marbles in a tin under her bed. At a school fair she won 16 more and dropped them into the tin. A dozen of her classmates play the same game at lunchtime. She then lost 137 marbles in a long unlucky afternoon of matches. She divided everything left in the tin equally among 5 small jars and kept one jar on her desk, giving the other jars away. Exactly 1 marble in the jar on her desk was chipped, so she threw it out, and her cousin later poured 32 marbles into that same jar. How many marbles were in the jar on her desk at the end?

Dev had 186 collector stickers in his folder, while his sister Leah had only 66 stickers in hers. Leah decided she had grown out of the hobby and gave every sticker she owned to Dev, who put them all in his folder. The hobby shop then rewarded Dev with 9 loyalty tokens for each sticker in that folder. When the season ended, every token was declared to be worth 7 charity points. The points were shared out equally among 3 charity teams. How many points did the team Dev supports receive?

Owen arrived at the stadium in the morning carrying 210 match flyers. Before noon he handed out 164 of them to people at the turnstiles. In the afternoon his teammate Sara took 39 flyers from his bag for the away stand, and 1 flyer blew out of his hands into the car park. In the evening he photocopied every flyer he still had, making 6 copies of each one for the school corridor. The corridor noticeboard already displayed 62 other sheets. How many sheets were on the corridor noticeboard in total?

The Halloran farm counted 219 eggs in its cold room at sunrise, and the farm records its yield in single eggs rather than in trays. During the morning Hugo packed 107 of them for the market van. At midday his sister Ada came in from the henhouse with 35 more eggs. Over the afternoon 7 eggs were cracked when a shelf tipped. In the evening every remaining egg was sold at the roadside stall for 8 rupees. How many rupees did the stall take?

A community hall began its refit with 97 boxes of floor tiles, and a supplier delivered 63 more boxes. Every box in the hall contained 4 tiles. The hall itself is 45 metres long. When the boxes were opened, 374 tiles were found to be cracked and were thrown out. Each surviving tile had to be fixed down with 6 metal clips, and every clip on the invoice was priced at 8 cents. The builder writes the bill in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents did the clips cost in total?

The regional seed bank started the spring with 180 paper packets of sunflower seed, and 41 further packets arrived from a partner bank. Each packet held 9 seeds, and the staff then found 74 loose seeds at the bottom of the storage bin and added them to the count. The garden log records growth in millimetres rather than in centimetres. Every seed that was sown came up as a plant bearing 3 flower heads, and each flower head opened with 7 outer petals. How many outer petals were there in the whole trial plot?

The Corner Kitchen opened in the morning with 106 sandwiches on the counter. Just after opening, the baker brought out 53 more from the kitchen. The lunchtime rush cleared 86 sandwiches from the counter. During the afternoon a catering delivery added 35 sandwiches to what was left. In the evening the owner cut every remaining sandwich into 2 halves for the late tray. How many pieces were on the late tray?

Ravi came back from the park with 188 conkers in his rucksack. The park he walks through has 62 chestnut trees. He found that 13 of his conkers were cracked and threw them away, and he gave 17 to his neighbour Nora, who had been collecting them all autumn too. He threaded each of his remaining conkers onto a cord next to 4 wooden beads. At the craft stall every bead could be exchanged for 3 tokens, so his tally tripled. How many tokens did Ravi receive?

The Riverside food bank had 86 tins on its shelves at the start of the collection week. Class A brought in 73 tins on Monday, and class B added 19 tins on Tuesday. On Wednesday class C arrived with 78 tins, and on Friday the corner shop donated 30 more. The building has 4 floors, and a dozen empty crates were stacked by the door. How many tins did the food bank have on its shelves at the end of the week?

The Beaumont Hotel counted 86 clean towels in the linen room first thing in the morning. Housekeeping brought up 40 towels from the laundry, then 12 more from the pool store, and later 21 from the staff room. During the afternoon guests took 56 towels from that room. In the evening the manager placed an order for the spa covering triple the towels still on the shelf, that is 3 times the number remaining. How many towels did the spa order cover?

The station parcel office held 55 parcels when it opened in the morning, and it records distances in kilometres rather than in metres. A van dropped off 28 further parcels before nine o'clock. During the morning 31 parcels were collected by their owners. In the afternoon a second van brought in 46 parcels. In the evening the clerk opened the shelves and found that every parcel still there contained 8 booklets. How many booklets were on the shelves?

A seafront stall started the morning with 12 helium balloons tied to its rail, and it measures its ribbon in centimetres rather than in metres. Before lunch 4 of the balloons burst in the wind. Over the afternoon 7 balloons were sold to families walking past. In the evening the supplier promised 6 replacement balloons for every balloon still tied to the rail, and delivered them that night. Each replacement balloon arrived with 7 ribbons attached. How many ribbons did the stall receive?

The puzzle club started the term with 98 blank sheets of card, and it times its rounds in seconds rather than in minutes. The club has 32 members. It turned out that 13 sheets were water damaged and had to be binned. Each usable sheet was printed on both sides to give 5 pages, and every page carried 6 puzzles. When the editors checked the set, 800 puzzles were duplicates and were struck out. Each puzzle that survived the check is worth 9 points in the end-of-term contest. How many points are on offer?

Lena arrived at the cottage with 116 seashells in her collecting bucket. Her brother Karl, who had been beachcombing all week, gave her 75 shells from his own tin. A rough tide washed 51 shells out of the bucket while she was paddling. The next morning she found 76 more shells along the tideline, and the beach there runs for 9 kilometres. On the last day Karl handed her another 77 shells before they drove home. How many shells did Lena take home?

The Ashwell juice plant began the week with 129 crates in its chiller, and a lorry delivered 13 more crates on Monday morning. The plant measures its juice in millilitres rather than in litres. Every crate in the chiller was packed with 9 bottles. A wholesale order took 902 bottles away on Wednesday, and 287 bottles were sold at the factory gate on Thursday. Each bottle still in the chiller on Friday was wrapped with 2 paper straws before going out. How many straws were used on Friday?

A research greenhouse started the trial with 202 seed trays, and every tray was cut down the middle into 2 half trays. Each half tray was then filled with 7 germination pods. The greenhouse is 18 metres wide. Jonas carried in 54 spare pods from the shed, and Mira brought 77 pods, rather more than Jonas had found. A technician later discovered 9 further pods on a bench and added them. During planting week 2585 pods were taken out to the field beds. How many pods were still in the greenhouse afterwards?

Marek began the month with 77 bus tokens in his wallet, and his route passes 14 stops on the way to work. Commuting used up 66 of the tokens, and he gave 8 of them to a visiting friend. He took what was left to the transport office, where each token was converted into 7 ride credits. He then spent 20 of those credits travelling at the weekend. The office upgraded every credit he still held into 6 bonus credits, and he used 5 of the bonus credits on the Monday after. How many credits does Marek have now?

The Hillcrest library had 217 films on its DVD rack on Monday morning, and it logs its loan periods in days rather than in weeks. On Monday members borrowed 31 of them. On Tuesday 45 discs came back and went straight onto the rack. On Wednesday another 30 were borrowed, and on Thursday 30 discs were returned to the rack. A dozen children signed up for the summer reading club that week. How many films were on the rack when the library opened on Friday?

A river hatchery keeps its young trout in 227 identical tanks, with 5 fingerlings in every tank. Half of the hatchery staff work at the weekend. Over the first cold month 183 of the fingerlings did not survive. A neighbouring hatchery then donated 24 healthy fingerlings, which joined the same tanks. At feeding time each fish in the hatchery is given 4 pellets. How many pellets does one feeding round use?
